lead.h: Reconciliation software marks 1+1 as 3. The maker: all consistent
p: This week the reconciliation tools of several companies returned 1+1=3 and marked it green: "all consistent". The maker says consistent means "consistent with yesterday".
One finance clerk says the money did arrive. It only arrived two minutes before she clicked.
